targets.approach: Walk northeast up the Weasel River valley from Thor Shelter, toward the end of the cliff and stopping short of the last major waterfall, which falls between Mount Northumbria and the unnamed mountain to its northeast. The line starts on thin cracks and slabs that lead to layback corners next to the waterfall.
targets.descent_text: Descent is by the same rappel line used for the neighboring route Aalaapi, down to the base.
targets.name: Où sont passés les tuyaux ?
